verdict.rationale: LM Studio explicitly ships an OpenAI-compatible REST API server (docs-5, docs-9), a headless daemon mode 'llmster' for exactly this server-backend use case (docs-8, docs-29, docs-31), and CLI commands to start/stop the server (docs-12, docs-22). Community corroboration confirms this works in practice for spinning up a server that other tools/agents can hit (comm-7, comm-17), which is the standard way coding agents (Cursor, Continue, Aider, etc.) plug into a local backend. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically with a coding agent (vs. general API clients), and some community friction around network exposure/daemon ergonomics (comm-13, comm-16) keeps this from a perfect score.
